name: Which run did it
what: Classifiers that ship with Silo say which run each conversation belongs to, and whether something was done by you or by an agent: what descends from a session opened over SSH from outside the computer, and not from an agent program, is you, and what neither a run nor you is shown to have done is unattributed. For each path, they say which run wrote it last and whether that run is still alive. They also say which paths many runs wrote.

suggest.why: Which agent did what is the first thing people ask of a computer several agents share, and six features need the answer.
